summary: Skier partially buried with head beneath the snow in a wind-slab avalanche in the east-facing Moose Creek Bowl on Mt. Bross (~14,100 ft, R2/D2, debris to ~13,550 ft); a ski partner dug the skier out in about five minutes and the party self-evacuated, with no injuries reported; Colorado's first avalanche accident of the 2026-27 season per a CAIC observation.
location: Moose Creek Bowl, Mt. Bross (east-facing slope above 14,000 ft)
responding_agency: Ski partner (self-rescue); Colorado Avalanche Information Center
notes: Freshness sweep run 38: Unofficial Networks 2026-10-26 + SnowBrains 2026-10-27, both citing the CAIC observation submitted by Ryan Buller; Park County Search and Rescue quoted on early-season conditions; CAIC daily forecasts resume November 1.
